replication.target_description: Candidate source: A=Monga, May, & Bagchi (2017), Study 4; B=Elicitation procedure: time or money; Future: distant or near; C=Implied wage rates to complete a task; in the money condition participants indicated how much they would need to be paid to complete a 4 hour survey. In the time condition participants indicated for how long they would be willing to work for $24. Both values converted into a standard wage.. Requested target: Relationship of activity timing and time scarcity with elicited wage rates under Time-Elicit (TEL; stating the maximum hours for a task) and Money-Elicit (MEL; stating the minimum money for a task) procedures; focus on activity timing.
